<br>'''Colonies''' are large parasitic structures that buff parasites, expand territory<!--need images-->, and spawn unique Parasites by accumulating [[#Colony Points|Colony Points]]. Colonies can only exist in the Overworld, Nether, and End by default.

==Generation ==
Colonies are generated by [[Stage IV Dispatcher|Stage IV Dispatchers]] at [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Ubiquitous Development Level 4]]. Each Colony has a large Colony Node structure at the center, at the center of the Node is a Parasitic Colony Core. Destroying the Colony Core will remove all of a Colony's effects and points.

Colonies' main line of defense is [[Architect|Architects]], which, as of now, only summon [[Succor|Succors]] as an attack. If the [[Evolution Phases|Evolution Phase]] is [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|7]] or higher, [[Airscrew|Airscrews]] will also spawn to defend Colonies.

===Structures===

Colonies create various structures which currently serve no functional purpose other than acting as difficult terrain by having steep builds and [[Dead Blood]], which heals parasites and damages any non-parasite entity each tick. Colonies generate structures in a square grid pattern outwards from the source, with repeated smaller structures packing the gaps in between larger varied ones.

The Colony Heart structure is the most visually outstanding, having a much of a gothic castle aesthetic, with a large main tower constructed of [[Biome Blocks|Concentrated Flesh Chunks]], and three to four lesser towers branching from the top, made of Compressed Hivestone and Hivestone Bricks<ref>The Hivestone Bricks indicate the parasite's intricate knowledge on architecture and aesthetic. The main structure is incredibly cool.</ref>. To find the Colony Heart, you must dig right in the middle of the structure.

Colony structures are built by [[Architect|Architects]] and [[Worker|Workers]]. This process is highly unfinished but currently happens in 3 stages:

#The Colony Core spawns Architects to move around the Colony.
#Architects spawn Workers which also move around the Colony.
#Incomplete Parasitic Colony Structures are placed in a pattern wherever Workers are present.

====Incomplete Parasitic Colony Structures====
[[File:IncompCStructure.png|thumb|Incomplete Parasitic Colony Structure Block]]
[[File:IncompCStructureG.png|thumb|Incomplete Parasitic Colony Structure in Ground]]
Incomplete Parasitic Colony Structures are blocks placed automatically while Workers are present. They behave much like tree saplings, having a random chance to grow into a Colony structure each tick. Incomplete Structures currently use the [[Parasite Biome|Hivesoil]] Texture as a placeholder.

====Structures====
There are two types of Parasite Structure blocks, type one and type two. The former has a smaller, more compact themed structures and slim, tall towers. The latter generates massive pillars and hollow flower-like structures, often with [[Biome Blocks|Flesh Blocks]]. It is to note that a double helix made of bone blocks, parasite rubble and parasite stain blocks is a predominant theme in these. The Colony Structures are arranged in a lattice, having a layer of type one structures followed by a layer of type two structures in the next layer. The Parasite Structures alternate from type one and two diagonally and have the same type of Parasite Structures in straight lines horizontally.

Every Parasite Structure has a small chance to replace a few of its blocks with [[Parasitic Growth Block|'''Parasitic Loot Blocks''']].

==Colony Points==
Colonies will spawn with one point. Every day, Colonies will gain one Colony point. These points will determine the presence and strength of the Colony's various effects. Each Colony can have a maximum of 100 points (with a maximum of 100,000 points for all Colonies in a given world) and Colonies do not share points.

===Radius===
As Colonies gain points they will gradually increase in both building and effect radius. 

*Colonies' building radius increases by 20 blocks every 2 points. Their base building radius is 60 blocks.
*Colonies' effect radius will increase by 40 blocks every point. Their base effect radius is 120 blocks.

===Base Stats===
Colonies grant Base Stat bonuses to all parasites in a world.

*Colonies apply 10% bonus to Health, Defense, and Damage every 20 points.
*Colonies apply a 50% boost to damage cap every 15 points.

===Evolution Phases===
Colonies will affect the rate of [[Evolution Phases]].

*Every 10 points, Colonies will increase Evolution Point gain and decrease Evolution Point loss by 5%.

===Reinforcement System===
Colonies can buff the [[Reinforcement System]] and allow for higher tier Beckons to appear. For every twenty points a Colony accumulates, it adds a 100% bonus for the Reinforcement System to spawn [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]]. Does not permit the spawning of [[Stage IV Beckon|Stage IV Beckons]].

===Natural Spawns ===
Colonies will allow certain mobs to spawn naturally (the [[Parasite Biome]] ignores this requirement). Point values are likely temporary.

*[[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent Parasites]] spawn naturally when there is a Colony with at least a certain number of points in the world.
** [[Colony Carrier|Colony Carriers]] require a Colony with at least 3 points.
** [[Heavy Bomber|Heavy Bombers]] require a Colony with at least 10 points.
** [[Wraith|Wraiths]] require a Colony with at least 15 points.
** [[Haunter|Haunters]] require a Colony with at least 25 points.
** [[Bogle|Bogles]] require a Colony with at least 30 points.


==Colony Buffs==
Colonies may also provide buffs for simply existing in a dimension, without the requirement of points.
===Parasite Death Devolution===
Parasites, instead of dying, will transform into their previous form if there is at least one Colony in the current dimension, including:

* [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive Parasites]] and [[Adapted Vermin]] turn into [[Moving Flesh]].<ref name="colony">Both Primitive and Adapted [[Burrower (Disambiguation)|Burrowers]], [[Tozoon (Disambiguation)|Tozoons]], and [[Devourer (Disambiguation)|Devourers]] do not turn into anything upon death, likely due to being largely a Work in Progress.</ref>
* [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted Parasites]] (excl. Adapted Vermin) turn into their Primitive Form.<ref name="colony" />
* [[Mangler|Manglers]] turn into [[Rupter|Rupters]] and Rupters turn into [[Buglin|Buglins]].
* [[Thrall|Thralls]] turn into [[Assimilated Adventurer|Assimilated Adventurers]].
* [[Herd|Herds]] turn into [[Host|Hosts]].
* [[Nexus Parasites]] will decrease a stage each death.

===Global Adaptation===
Colonies being present in a world will allow parasites to access Global [[Adaptation System|Adaptation]]. When a parasite that can adapt is killed within a Colony's effect radius, it will send a "signal" to the Colony, which is the most common damage type it suffered. Each newly spawned parasites in the dimension the Colony is in will have already learned the damage type that Colonies receive the most, but only by a little bit. The more signals a Colony receives of a certain damage type, the more newly spawned parasites will be adapted to that damage type upon spawning. Parasites that die while on fire will not send a signal. If the Colony Core is destroyed, it will delete the recorded damage types, and newly spawned parasites will no longer have those adaptations upon spawning.

If a parasite is afflicted with [[Link]], it will be able to contribute to Global Adaptation without having to be in a Colony's radius.
